firstPlayerRule: In the basic game, the player who most resembles the game’s monster begins and takes the starting-player token.
houseFallback: If this criterion does not suit your group, agree to choose randomly. This is a house rule.
clarifications: After the monster moves, pass the starting-player token to the left; its new holder begins the next movement phase.
In the experienced-player setup, the player to the left of whoever placed the final floor tile takes the starting-player token and begins instead.
interpretation: This is an English summary of the identified German rulebook. Its comparison refers to the game’s monster, not an arbitrary monster chosen by the group.

internalEvidence: Starting instructions were checked on rendered publisher pages, including relevant mode context. Publisher source context: https://2f-games.com/2f-spiele/finstere-flure/. Finding: In the basic game, the player who most resembles the game’s monster begins and takes the starting-player token. Local source SHA-256: a329bc7369041f19d3e8ccacdf4f6a5ff5f39b5310d8835a9237f8d08d6371d6. Rendered German pages 3, 6 and 7 were inspected before preparation. The basic criterion is not applied to the advanced floor-tile setup. Rio Grande’s separately hosted English Fearsome Floors PDF corroborates the title and game identity but includes an alternative-selection sentence absent from this German passage; that alternative is not silently imported into this edition. Editorial review 2026-09-23: Codex inspected the rendered starting passage, edition, relevant mode and round context, source-page references and visible qualifications. The owner authorized factual review on 2026-09-22 in task Reload localhost. Directory only: The comparison requires this game’s monster, and experienced setup uses component placement order.
uncertainty: No starting tie-break is stated alongside this instruction.
